paragraphs.text: Stenn was a human wizard from New Argive on Dominaria .

Stenn was a young nobleman of New Argive. He had fair skin and a black goatee. He usually wore gold-embroidered and fur-lined finery. The heir to a long and prestigious noble Argivian lineage, Stenn pursued his quarry with ruthless efficiency and total dedication, stopping at nothing to do the bidding of his king.

During the second Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria, he was appointed by King Darien XLVIII to discover Phyrexian sleeper agents and root them out by any means necessary. To achieve these ends, he dispatched Shanid to the Balduvian Steppe to root out potential sleepers.

In 4562 AR , he presided over the peace summit at Oyster Bay to end hostilities between Keld and Benalia in the Ice Rime Hills . The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion and several of the Benalish knights were revealed as Phyrexian sleeper agents . After traveling with both planeswalkers, Jodah , and Jaya to Argivia, he was revealed to be a sleeper agent himself, having secretly been infecting the city with Phyrexians.
The compleated creature that once had been Stenn was killed by Karn and Jaya.
